findings: Read Pre-IPO section (p121-128), special rights (p125) and all director bios (p280-286) before opening the candidate. Board at listing = 9 (5 exec founders/employees, 1 NED Huang Hongman, 3 INEDs with no investor link). Single Series A round (June 2021); Director appointment rights are generic and terminate at Listing; no observer right. Candidate's quotes all verified verbatim on the cited pdf pages with correct printed pages. Disagreement/addition: the candidate missed the Accountants' Report note (pdf p369, printed 'n/a' in INDEX) that Huang Hongman's emoluments for services to the Group were 'borne by a series A investor'. This is the strongest hint that Huang is an investor-side director, but the note does not name which of the eight Series A investors, and does not say he was nominated by/represents it; his bio names Qianhai Zhongzhao, which the prospectus never links to Qianhai Ark (differently named entities). Under the strict standard (identified institution; no inference beyond text) this is not 1; and there is no affirmative statement of no pre-IPO seat (a generic appointment right existed), so not 0. Value stays unknown.
residual_uncertainty: Real possibility the true value is 1 (Huang's pay borne by a Series A investor, joined June 2023 while Series A shareholders' agreements gave Director appointment rights), but the investor is not identified in the prospectus. Recommend leaving NaN unless an external source (not permitted here) identifies the nominating investor.
